game: Tales of the Arabian Nights Remake

sections.Profile:
Pedretti Gaming's 2026 remake of the 1996 Williams game Tales of the Arabian Nights returns players to ancient Baghdad to collect jewels from seven tales, spin the magic lamp and battle the Genie to rescue the princess. Built with Planetary Pinball Supply, it comes as a Legacy Edition with the original artwork and a 30th Anniversary Edition with new art by Brian Allen of Flyland Designs, and its software by Athyrio Games adds color DMD-style animations and RGB lighting in the lamp and the Genie.
